result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_avg_clustering_coefficient()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get average clustering coefficient for the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L10461-L10519){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_avg_clustering_coefficient() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the mean of all node clustering coefficients. This is a global measure of how clustered the graph is overall. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Average clustering coefficient (`0.0` to `1.0`). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Values close to `1.0` indicate a highly clustered network (many triangles). Values close to `0.0` indicate a tree-like or sparse network structure. Small-world networks typically have high clustering coefficients combined with low average path lengths. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Compare clustering in different graph types: ::: {#0fe03bdc .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec triangle = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) # Returns 1.00 (highly clustered) triangle.get_avg_clustering_coefficient() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#c86e695e .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Star graph: not clustered star = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="center") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("center", "A") .add_edge("center", "B") .add_edge("center", "C") ) # Returns 0.00 (not clustered) star.get_avg_clustering_coefficient() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 0.0 ``` ::: :::
